tatenga inaitu ku tadatangah , mikuwanay tu kanatal uydatu umikuwanany, nikalawlawan a sakaudip mala mipataya tutademaw. . tusa satu a mihcaan ci Culi-an. kase-cu. kante'-lela-se mibabelihan patasasa'en cinida, misakaput ci Kante'-lela-se tu hitay a cen-fu, epingen ku kawaw, mapalekal ku Pawsuotan mibabelih, malingatu aca misapatas tu kawaw. sadikuday i cacay a malebut walu a lasubu lima
